description: Pouch.me: build a Nutrition Facts panel in FDA's format (21 CFR 101.9; USDA FSIS meat and poultry such as jerky also use it) from your user's own values per serving or per 100 g: product type, serving size in grams and in words, net weight, the 15 required nutrients, the bag's printable faces and the space for the panel. The tool picks the format that fits. Returns the panel as an SVG preview (and a PDF print file on request), its minimum print size, the printed values, print instructions and plain-English notes, and the rule and data versions. It doesn't calculate from recipes. Ask your user for the values; don't guess them. General information, not an FDA approval: the brand is responsible for its label.

description.description: Optional short description of the bag for the print instructions, e.g. 'stand-up pouch 120 x 190 mm'.
description.title: Description

faces_mm.description: Every printable face that can carry label copy, as [[width, height], ...] in mm with the seals left out, e.g. [[120, 190], [120, 190]] for front and back. The label area decides which formats are allowed. Required unless total_label_area_sq_in is given.
faces_mm.title: Faces Mm

nf_panel_mm.description: The space set aside for the panel, [width, height] in mm. The tool picks the format that fits it.
nf_panel_mm.title: Nf Panel Mm

place.description: Which panel of the bag it goes on: back (default), side or front. Printed in the instructions.
place.title: Place

total_label_area_sq_in.description: The bag's total label area in square inches, instead of faces_mm.
total_label_area_sq_in.title: Total Label Area Sq In

percent.description: Meat or poultry as a percent of the recipe.
percent.title: Percent

species.description: The meat or poultry species; plant for plant-based products.
species.title: Species

state.description: raw (default) or cooked: how the meat was weighed for that percent.
state.title: State

format.description: Leave out to let the tool choose (recommended), or force one: std (standard vertical), sbs (standard, vitamins side by side), simp (simplified), tab (tabular), small_tab (small-package tabular) or linear (one paragraph).
format.title: Format

simplified.description: auto (default: the simplified format when it is allowed and nothing else fits), true (use it when allowed) or false (never).
simplified.title: Simplified

net_weight_g.description: Net weight of the package in grams. It sets the servings per container, and whether the bag is one serving or needs two columns.
net_weight_g.title: Net Weight G

servings_per_container.description: Optional. Worked out from the net weight and the serving size when left out, and checked against them when given.
servings_per_container.title: Servings Per Container

category.description: Product type. It sets the reference amount that decides the serving rules. USDA (FSIS) meat and poultry types (beef_pork_jerky_dried, meat_snack_sticks, poultry_jerky_dried, poultry_snack_sticks, bacon) also need product.meat.
category.title: Category

meat.description: Only if the product contains meat or poultry: decides whether FDA or USDA FSIS applies.

name.description: Product name. Used in the print instructions and the file title.
name.title: Name

household.description: Serving size in words, e.g. '1 cookie' or '2/3 cup'. It prints before the grams.
household.title: Household

per_100g.description: The same 15 values per 100 g instead of per serving.

per_serving.description: Values per serving. All 15 are required; use 0 only if the product really has none. Calories as a number; total_fat, sat_fat, trans_fat, total_carb, fiber, total_sugars, added_sugars and protein in g; cholesterol, sodium, calcium, iron and potassium in mg; vitamin_d in mcg.

bag.description: The bag and the space for the panel.

outputs.description: Files to return: svg (default: a preview at exact size) and/or pdf (the print file, as a data: link, about 40 to 55 KB).
outputs.title: Outputs

values.description: The customer's own nutrition values: give exactly one of per_serving or per_100g. The tool doesn't calculate from recipes.

name: make_nutrition_facts_panel
title: Make a Nutrition Facts panel
